CourseName: CEN3722 - Introduction to Human Computer Interfaces

Assignments.Title: Assignment 1.1: Project Scope Definition and Formal Project Description
Assignments.TopicTitles: Defining Project Scope in HCI Design, Overview of Target Application Platforms, Android Platform: Characteristics and Constraints, iOS Platform: Characteristics and Constraints, Windows Platform: Characteristics and Constraints, Web Platform: Characteristics and Constraints, Platform Selection: Criteria and Decision-Making, Design and Development Tools by Platform
Assignments.ExtraInstructions: Students must determine the scope of the group project and turn in their ideas as an assignment. They must research and make a determination of the type of App they wish to develop (of the 4 available: Windows App, Mobile App (Android or iOS), Web App). They must have design and development environments that will be used determined. Their project description should cover the scope of what they intend to develop.
